notice: Derived data, not an original USGS file: rewritten by the VeloPhi project (scripts/chem/build_aqueous.py) from the PHREEQC 3 database files phreeqc.dat, wateq4f.dat and minteq.v4.dat of the U.S. Geological Survey and from hand-entered supplements. Modifications: redox states uncoupled into separate components, every species rewritten as a formation reaction with one analytic log K(T), the three files merged, a subset of elements kept. The original distribution: https://www.usgs.gov/software/phreeqc-version-3 ; its User Rights Notice: scripts/chem/licenses/USGS-PHREEQC-NOTICE.txt. Parkhurst and Appelo (2013), USGS Techniques and Methods 6-A43.
